finding: EO12941 §§1–4 adopts minimum seismic standards; directs inventory and estimates; gives FEMA notification, one-time comprehensive congressional report and biennial reporting functions, NIST support and agency exemptions; requires ICSSC updates. Signature Dec 1 1994. EO13717 §5 expressly revokes it Feb 2 2016 while separately adopting standards, so policy continuity in a successor is not continuing original authority. Earlier first performance cannot be imputed to 2016. The May 19 2005 VHA Directive reports congressional submission in December 2000, but NEHRP FY2003–04 biennial report says a draft went to OMB late FY2000 and was revised and resubmitted there. Different recipients and timing; seek actual transmission/receipt, inventory, exemptions, updates and biennial deliveries. Recurring and one-time provisions require individual dates; neither issuance deadline nor later repeal resolves contradiction. Strong whole prospective NO lead; exact clause-specific lifecycle incomplete.
